derivation_limits: Slope for1SD BMI requires exact standardization constant to convert to perkg/m2; do not derive SD from robust or age-standardized meanCIs.
Sex-specific slopes do not generally identify pooled common slope without within-stratum covariate cross-products/weights and appropriate interaction specification.
Log-outcome slope cannot become raw conditional-mean slope by multiplying marginal mean; requires transformation base and conditional retransformation law.
Coefficient confidence interval concerns estimator uncertainty, not person-level conditional variance. Cluster robust/MI estimates cannot be inverted as simple OLS residual variance.
No conditional TC-HDL covariance or fullcompatiblecovariance matrix recovered in this branch.
Measured-assay laws require explicit population/selection/measurement transfer; they do not establish error-free latent concentration relations.
